name: Clarity
description: Assesses how clearly the summary conveys the main ideas of the news article. It should be easy to understand and free of ambiguity.

name: Conciseness
description: Measures the ability of the summary to present the key points of the news article in a succinct manner without unnecessary details.

name: Relevance
description: Evaluates how well the summary captures the most important aspects of the news article, ensuring all critical points are included.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the summary to engage the reader, making them interested in the content of the news article.

name: Accuracy
description: Checks the factual correctness of the information presented in the summary relative to the original news article.

name: Coherence
description: Measures how logically the summary flows, with well-structured sentences and a clear progression of ideas.
